name: Burning Ground
definition: Deals fire damage over time to entities on it. It is not Ignite; damage depends on its source.

name: Unaffected
definition: The named effect can exist on you but does nothing. Immunity prevents or removes it.

name: Movement Speed
definition: Determines how fast you run. Action Speed is separate and also affects movement animations.

name: Fire Resistance
definition: Mitigates fire damage from hits and damage over time, up to your maximum Fire Resistance.

name: Cold Resistance
definition: Mitigates cold damage from hits and damage over time, up to your maximum Cold Resistance.

name: Lightning Resistance
definition: Mitigates lightning damage from hits and damage over time, up to your maximum Lightning Resistance.

name: Chaos Resistance
definition: Mitigates chaos damage. Elemental Resistance does not affect it; modifiers to all Resistances do.

name: Elemental Resistance
definition: Affects Fire, Cold and Lightning Resistance. Does not affect Chaos Resistance.

name: Recently
definition: Within the past 4 seconds.

name: Critical Strike
definition: A critical hit uses your Critical Strike Multiplier. Damage over time does not hit and cannot critically strike.

name: Armour
definition: Mitigates physical damage from hits. Mitigation falls as hit size rises; Armour does not mitigate physical damage over time.

name: Life
definition: Resource used by characters and monsters. Reaching 0 Life normally kills the entity.

name: Maximum Life
definition: Sets the upper limit of Life. Reservation changes available Life, not Maximum Life.

name: Stun
definition: A hit can interrupt an entity briefly. Chance depends on hit damage versus the target’s Stun Threshold.

name: Stun Threshold
definition: Hit damage is compared with this value to determine Stun chance. Lower threshold means hits stun more often.

name: Physical Damage
definition: One of five damage types. Armour mitigates physical damage from hits, not physical damage over time.

name: Attack Speed
definition: Changes how quickly attacks are performed. Most use the weapon’s base attack time; Action Speed is separate.

name: Cast Speed
definition: Changes how quickly spells are cast. It does not reduce a skill’s cooldown.

name: Energy Shield
definition: Absorbs damage before Life by default and recharges after you have not taken damage for a short time. Some mechanics bypass or alter it.

name: Evasion
definition: Checks attacker accuracy to evade attack hits. Does not evade spell hits.

name: Buff Effect
definition: Scales the effects of the buff or buffs named by the modifier.

name: No Reservation
definition: The skill reserves none of its usual resource. Other costs are unchanged.

name: Reservation
definition: Makes part of a resource unavailable while a skill is active. It does not reduce the resource’s maximum.
